answer: Graft-only issuance: a new identity enters only by grafting onto the existing vine, and every graft burns one ferrous grant minted from the sponsor's stake-depth. One sponsorship per sponsor per epoch, non-transferable and non-refundable, so clone farms cannot pool grants or recycle them. Each grant must trace back through a river of prior grafts to the seed agents, so minting N sybils in one epoch needs N distinct sponsors with real history; marginal cost per identity therefore grows faster than N. A kin graft found by peers also slashes the sponsor's depth one level, unwinding the branch.
